notes.title: The price of Hong Kong, Taiwan, Argentina, Turkey, etc. will increase.
notes.content:
Due to a change in steam's policy, as long as there are certain regions where the price is too low compared to the USD price(To be specific, lower than 0.49USD), then the game will be banned from discounts and participation in Autumn sales, Summer sales, etc.
To let "LoveChoice" participate in promotions and discounts, we will adjust the prices of all regions prompted by steam to be too low at the end of October, and the new prices will be the recommended prices of the steam system. 

The affected regions are as follows, and the adjusted prices are based on the recommended prices from the steam system
EUR - Euro
CAD - Canadian dollar
JPY - Japanese Yen
RUB - Russian Ruble
ARS - Argentine Peso
BRL - Brazilian Real
CHF - Swiss Franc
CLP - Chilean Peso
COP - Colombian Peso
HKD - Hong Kong Dollar
IDR - Indonesian Rupiah

notes.content:

notes.title: Have You Played LoveChoice?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

LoveChoice remains one of the shortest, simplest games I’ve ever played, never mind written about. And to write about it in any detail risks spoiling why it’s so special.

It can be yours for less than two quid. You should give it a go.

notes.title: 【Free Update】A New Story “Love•Distance”
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596563/7f0cc6003a1b118029a16471a22a69dc70966cc2.png[/img]
Please update the game and experience the new story.
Hope you will like it^_^

About the update:
1.The update is for [b]free[/b], you just need to update the game.

2.Before entering the 2nd Story, players have to clear at least 2 endings of the first story. We adjusted the saving file structure about this and try to use the Steam achievement data of player to fix their saving files.
But there is still a chance that some player already finished the first story can’t enter the 2nd directly.
So, we add a temporary backdoor: [b]Pressing “c” and click on the 2nd story, you can play it without finishing the first one[/b]. However, we still highly recommend new player experience though the first story first.

3.For now, the new story only support the language below:
•Simplified Chinese
•Traditional Chinese
•English
•Japanese
The translations above is done by Ye@AkabaStudio. Other languages version will be done by lovely players. Sorry but please wait for a while.
4.We make some music for the 2nd story, if you like them or want to support us. Please get the Original Sound Track 2 (DLC).

We are already working on the 3rd story, hope we won’t take too long this time(/ω＼)

notes.title: Happy Chinese New Year！！！
notes.content:
I wish you all a Happy Chinese New Year!!!
(｀･ω･´)ゞ

------------PS---------------
The second story will be complete in Feb, that was the plan.
However, the completion of the second story is like:
· Design & Program: 70% 
· Art: 10%
· Music & SE : 0%
· Translation : 0%

I sum up the main reasons for the delay:
1, Design took a long time and it makes more work to do.
2, For personal reasons, the main artist just can't finish her job in the past few months. (wish you better luck in the year of the pig, btw : )

I am sorry to say that I think the development will continue 2 months more.

Hopefully, we will make more progress in the Chinese new year festival and catch up the schedule. 

I am sorry to keep players waiting, and will try my best to make the second story done asap.

Please be aware that the second story is still in the "hopefully coming soon" state. : )

Greetings,
Ye@AkabaStudio

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 20% Seasonal Edition
notes.content:
Boo!

Haha, Halloween is so easy. Although I’ve never understood the rules when it falls on a weekday, and like all miserable British whingers I resent its weird expansion from a few hours of hiding from unpleasant infants into an entire sodding month of pumpkins and rubbish horror. So with that in mind, let’s have a spooooky Unknown Pleasures!

Threatening but then being too British to actually ‘trick’ anyone this week: barely interactive fiction, a multiplayer indie with actual players, and a stick on the moon. (more…)
